components.name: body
components.description: Characters after the prefix. Anthropic's pages read state no length, alphabet or suffix. Two scanner rule sets by different maintainers are consistent with 93 characters from letters, digits, underscore and hyphen followed by the literal AA (claim body-tool-corroborated); one provider API-reference example hint also ends in AA (claim hint-example-ends-aa), which is an example, not a rule.

claims.statement: The provider's key-type table lists the Claude API key as sk-ant-api03-..., created in Claude Console > Settings > API keys, distinct from the Compliance Access Key (sk-ant-api01-...) and the Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-...).

sources.supports: Key-type table row: 'Claude API key ( sk-ant-api03-... ) | Claude Console > Settings > API keys | Calling Claude models through the Claude API | No' (works with the Compliance API: No).

claims.statement: Provider pages write the Claude API key in examples as the prefix sk-ant-api03- followed by an ellipsis in place of any body, in an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY assignment.

sources.supports: 'export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-...' in the zsh example under 'API key'.

claims.statement: The authentication page describes a Claude API key as a static sk-ant-api... secret (the version digits are not given there), sent as a bearer token in the Authorization header, with the x-api-key header still supported.

sources.supports: Method table: 'API key | Static sk-ant-api... secret sent as a bearer token in the Authorization header'; 'The legacy x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY header is still supported in place of Authorization.'

claims.statement: A Claude API key is created in the Claude Console under Settings > API keys, as a personal key, a service account key or a legacy workspace key.

sources.supports: 'To view your existing keys or create a new one, go to Settings -> API keys.'; key types personal, service account and workspace (legacy).
'Go to Settings -> API keys in the Claude Console and click Create key.'

claims.statement: The Console shows the full key, which starts with sk-ant-, only once at creation; a lost key cannot be viewed again, and the Admin API never returns a key's secret value, only a partially redacted hint.

sources.supports: 'The Console shows the full key, which starts with sk-ant- , only once, at creation.' and 'They never return a key's secret value, only a partially redacted hint.'

claims.statement: Two scanner rule sets by different maintainers are consistent with a body of 93 characters from [A-Za-z0-9_-] followed by the literal AA after sk-ant-api03-; no Anthropic page read states a length, alphabet or suffix.

sources.supports: Anthropic rule regex sk-ant-api03-[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{93}AA (cmd/generate/config/rules/anthropic.go, read on the default branch 2026-10-04; the existing source record pins gitleaks 8.30.1).
Anthropic detector regex (sk-ant-(?:admin01|api03)-[\w\-]{93}AA) (pkg/detectors/anthropic/anthropic.go, read on the default branch 2026-10-04; the existing source record pins trufflehog 3.97.4).

claims.statement: The provider's API-reference example partial_key_hint for an API key reads sk-ant-api03- followed by three characters, an ellipsis and a four-character tail whose last two characters are AA; it is one example and states no rule.

sources.supports: Example response partial_key_hint value: sk-ant-api03-, three characters, '...', four characters ending AA. Field described as 'Partially redacted hint for the API key.'

claims.statement: The provider returns a partially redacted hint (not the secret) for each API key and describes it as such.

sources.supports: 'partial_key_hint: string or null - Partially redacted hint for the API key.'
Admin API 'never return a key's secret value, only a partially redacted hint'.

claims.statement: sk-ant-api01- (Compliance Access Key) and sk-ant-admin01- (Admin API key) are different key types listed beside the Claude API key; they are real secrets of other classes and a scoped twin, not globally benign.

sources.supports: Key prefix paragraph: 'sk-ant-admin01- is an Admin API key ... sk-ant-api01- is a Compliance Access Key'; the table lists three distinct key types.

claims.statement: The CLI authentication page's sample status output shows a user_oauth profile credential beginning sk-ant-oat01-, a prefix other than sk-ant-api03-; the page does not name this credential's class or give its format.

sources.supports: 'Profile (user_oauth) * sk-ant-oat01-EXA...' in the ant auth status sample output.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Proposed revision of revision 1: separates the provider-documented prefix, issuance and display-form claims from the tool-corroborated body claim (revision 1 provider-source and dossier-research claims mix the two), drops the descriptivePattern because only the prefix is provider-documented, and adds provider statements read on 2026-10-04. Original revision, currentContract and fixture expectations are unchanged.

openQuestions.question: Does Anthropic guarantee the 93-character body, the alphabet or the AA tail, or only the sk-ant-api03- prefix? No provider page read states them; one API-reference example hint ends in AA.

What does the 03 in sk-ant-api03- denote, may other versions (for example api04) be issued for Claude API keys, and was an earlier-version Claude API key form issued? The authentication page writes sk-ant-api... without version digits.
Do personal, service account and workspace keys share one body format, and did earlier keys differ?
What credential class does the sk-ant-oat01- prefix in the CLI status sample denote, and is it a separate family?
